summary.what_it_does: This is a Reddit subreddit post listing community-run getting-started resources for Stable Diffusion. It groups links into sections for DreamStudio, local installation guides, FAQ on hardware and NSFW filter settings, tips, prompt development tools, training resources, and community generators and search engines. The FAQ states Stable Diffusion needs a 4GB+ VRAM GPU locally, with Nvidia cards officially supported and AMD and Apple M1 support available unofficially. The page notes that its resources are not endorsed or provided by Stability AI.
notable: Curated list of community resources, prompt search engines, and CLIP-based tools
FAQ on GPU requirements and unofficial AMD and Apple M1 support
DreamStudio offers 200 free credits to new users
caveats: Community resources are not endorsed, vetted, or provided by Stability AI; discretion advised
Stable Diffusion requires a 4GB+ VRAM GPU locally; higher-resolution generation needs much stronger cards
Intel-based Macs currently do not work with Stable Diffusion, per the FAQ
DreamStudio does not allow disabling its NSFW filter
